purpose: Backups of the original notebooks and README. Only README is edited; automated execution uses corrected copies in pipeline_notebooks/.
changes: README: replace the historical write-up with current setup, commands, execution flow and evaluation notes.
Root notebooks: retained unchanged, with copies also preserved here.
Corrected notebook copies: execute modular helpers with run-scoped outputs and logging.
Shared stratified holdout and real cross-validation replace training-on-training parameter selection.
Fold-local cross-fitted genre encoding, scaling and PCA are persisted with each estimator.
Combined stage reuses the CV-selected classifier and loads a complete high-popularity regression pipeline.
Class weighting where supported and hit-class F1 replace overall accuracy as classifier selection criteria.
Invalid empty voting estimator and unsupported parameter combinations are removed.
Full profile uses all data with a practical 30-candidate budget; original_budget retains original search counts with corrected evaluation.
